title: Sex-specific personality metatrait profiles and their associations with APOE, PICALM variants, and cognitive performance in healthy middle-aged adults: a cluster-based analysis.
summary: In 192 healthy middle-aged adults, profile-specific genetic/cognitive associations were reported chiefly in women after FDR correction; cross-sectional associations do not establish causation. FDR correction and sensitivity analyses were reported; no independent replication, with modest sample size and cross-sectional design.
ai_technology: Sex-stratified Ward hierarchical clustering defined Stability/Plasticity personality profiles used to test APOE/PICALM and cognitive associations.
organization: John Paul II Geriatric Hospital, Katowice, Poland
